overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a two-member encounter at a member's home was a social interaction about a Boy Scout troop, not deliberation on public business.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the three-member Board deliberated outside a properly noticed meeting during a September 2013 encounter at a member's residence.
allegations.key_passage: While it is undisputed that a quorum of the Board spoke outside of a meeting on that date, our investigation has revealed no evidence that this interaction concerned public business.
